description: Defines a repository class for managing external HARQ buffer contexts in a hardware-accelerated communication system, including related data structures, constants, and methods for buffer management.

classes.name: ext_harq_buffer_context_repository
classes.description: Manages a collection of buffer context entries for external HARQ buffers, providing methods to get and free entries, with capacity checks and debug support.

methods.name: ext_harq_buffer_context_repository
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the repository, checks buffer capacity, and sets debug mode.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a buffer context entry for a given codeblock ID.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Marks a buffer context entry as free, unless in debug mode.
